pinterest.description: Google says ATLAS is built from 15 million aggregated and de-identified human-AI interactions across more than 150 countries, 140 languages, 800 occupations and 4,000 tasks. Use that as a simple checklist: tie one AI tool to one repeated task, then test whether it reduces time or rework. Save this if you want a practical way to judge your next AI tool, and comment with the task you'd measure first.
pinterest.title: How do you tell if AI actually saves time?
